# FreeCast, Inc. Rings the Closing Bell


#### March 13, 2026


FreeCast, Inc. ([Nasdaq: CAST](https://www.nasdaq.com/market-activity/stocks/cast) ), an enterprise technology company simplifying global media distribution through a unified Platform-as-a-Service (PAAS) model designed for telecoms, ISPs, governments, brands, and MDUs, visits the Nasdaq MarketSite in Times Square. Powering the Future of TV.


In honor of the occasion, **William (Bill) Mobley, CEO & Founder** rings the Closing Bell.


[Source: www.nasdaq.com/events/freecast-inc-rings-closing-bell](https://www.nasdaq.com/events/freecast-inc-rings-closing-bell)
